n = int(input())
K = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007

def sum_mod(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= MOD:
        a -= MOD
    return a

def product_mod(a, b):
    res = a * b
    if res >= MOD:
        res %= MOD
    return res

class Mat:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.mat = [[0] * M for _ in range(N)]
        
    def clear(self):
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                self.mat[i][j] = 0
                
    def set_identity(self):
        self.clear()
        for i in range(min(self.N, self.M)):
            self.mat[i][i] = 1
            
    def transpose(self):
        t = Mat(self.M, self.N)
        t.clear()
        for i in range(self.M):
            for j in range(self.N):
                t.mat[i][j] = self.mat[j][i]
        return t
    
    def row(self, r):
        return self.mat[r]
    
    def add(self, other):
        res = Mat(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.mat[i][j] = sum_mod(self.mat[i][j], other.mat[i][j])
        return res
    
    def scale(self, scalar):
        res = Mat(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.mat[i][j] = product_mod(self.mat[i][j], scalar)
        return res
    
def multiply(a, b):
    N = a.N
    M = b.M
    X = a.M
    out = Mat(N, M)
    out.clear()
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(X):
            if a.mat[i][j]:
                for k in range(M):
                    out.mat[i][k] = sum_mod(out.mat[i][k], product_mod(a.mat[i][j], b.mat[j][k]))
    return out
